part: Regulations page composition — RegulationsLedger (real page component, not the ListSurfaceShell primitive)
source: dc.html p2 (#p2): masthead, band tiles, 'N regulations · grouped by band · Show as one list' + Sort row, rail (Filters card: MODE/JURISDICTION/TOPIC/SOURCE TIER, then 'Obligations · next 30 days', then Legend), band-sectioned rows. This spec exists per the operator's own complaint ('the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right — same on every page; you are NOT matching the images directly') — it measures the COMPOSED page, not a shell primitive fed invented props, so a future regression that puts the facets back in the content column, or drops the sort row, or reorders the rail, is caught here.
notes: The pre-existing list-surface.json spec measures ListSurfaceShell/ListSurfaceRailCards in isolation via the 'list-surface-1440' mount (a minimal fixture: one facetGroup, no sortRow, no topic/tier). This spec measures the REAL RegulationsLedger composition (24-row fixture, matching capture-compose-lists-screenshots.mjs), so the sort row, the Topic/Source-tier facets, and the rail's actual top-to-bottom order are all exercised end to end.
Fixture is invented sample data with the real shape (same helper as the evidence screenshot); the audit asserts geometry/placement/labels, never fixture values.

The Filters rail card sits ABOVE the Legend rail card (p2's own top-to-bottom rail order) — asserted via a DOM-order sibling-combinator selector, since 'present but in the wrong place' was the exact original defect, not mere absence.

The rail's OBLIGATIONS · NEXT 30 DAYS card (lane comp-oblig, 2026-09-08) is measured here for presence, DOM order between Filters and Legend, its head label and 'Calendar →' link, and its four-row cap: artboard 02/id="p2" draws four dated rows, and the mount's obligation fixture deliberately includes a fifth event 90 days out so the card's own 30-day window is proven in the real composition, not only in obligation-rail-select.npmtest.mjs.

children.name: Filters rail card mounts before the Legend rail card (rail order: Filters, then Legend)
children.note: The sibling-combinator selector only matches when filters-rail's DOM node precedes legend-rail's — this is the placement check, not a style check.

children.name: Filters rail card carries checkbox rows (not chip pills) for every facet group
Filters rail card's facet groups include Topic (p2 rail: MODE / JURISDICTION / TOPIC / SOURCE TIER)
children.note: Text-presence check narrowed to the group-heading paragraphs: confirms RegulationsLedger's facetGroups array actually includes the Topic group, not just Mode/Jurisdiction.

children.name: Filters rail card's facet groups include Source tier
Sort/count row renders above the rows, with the count + 'grouped by band'/flat-toggle text and Sort control
Sort row carries the real 'My order' option (all four options — Regulations is the one surface with 'My order')
Obligations rail card mounts AFTER the Filters card (rail order: Filters, Obligations, Legend)
children.note: Sibling-combinator placement check: only matches when filters-rail's DOM node precedes obligations-rail's.

children.name: Obligations rail card mounts BEFORE the Legend card
Obligations rail card head carries the artboard's exact label
Obligations rail card head carries the artboard's 'Calendar →' link
children.note: The link is authored `inline-flex` (so its 24px hit box centres on the head baseline); the head is itself a flex container, so CSS blockifies the flex ITEM's display to `flex` — that is the value a browser computes, and the value asserted here.

children.name: Obligations rail card renders the artboard's four dated rows, and no more (the fifth fixture event is 90 days out, outside the 30-day window)
Filters rail card head carries the artboard's Clear link, unconditionally
children.note: Artboard 02/id="p2" draws `Clear 1` and artboard 04/id="p4" draws a bare `Clear` in the same head position, so the link is part of the card's anatomy in BOTH states. It used to render only while a facet was active, which is why the composition capture showed no Clear link at all. With nothing selected it is disabled rather than a press that silently does nothing (operator audit P0 1.1).

children.name: Filters rail card foot carries artboard 02's own footnote, verbatim

expect.text: Counts are live for the current selection. Filters never hide behind a button; the band tiles above are the fourth facet.

forbid.name: no content-column facet chip strip above the rows (the original defect: filters rendered as pill chips in the content column, not the rail)
forbid.reason: Operator audit: 'the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right — same on every page.' The facet chip strip that used to sit above the row list in the content column is gone; the SAME data now renders as the rail's FiltersRailCard exclusively.

forbid.name: the literal word UNSCORED anywhere in a row
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.1: this literal token never appears anywhere in the product (Absence renders the fixed-vocabulary 'unscored' reason via small-caps CSS on the lowercase word, not the bare uppercase word — textContent reads the real, lowercase, DOM text).

forbid.name: no trailing 'N regulations tracked across N jurisdictions' line below the band cards
forbid.reason: Artboard 02/id="p2" draws nothing below the band cards. Both figures that line restated are already stated by regions the artboard DOES draw: the corpus total and the jurisdiction count in the masthead scope line, the total again in the sort row. Removed on all three surfaces that share this shared slot (/regulations, /market, /operations).
